notes: Researched 2026-11-14. Neither retailer offers a public API to fill a cart, so 'ordering' means copying a store-formatted list and opening the store's app or site; the family reviews and checks out. Anything marked unconfirmed could not be verified from a retailer page and should be shown with that caveat.

sams.name: Sam's Club
services: Free Curbside Pickup — no order minimum or fees (per the club page)
Delivery as soon as 1 hour, $10 extra, no minimum (per the club page)
Scan & Go in the app (skip the checkout line)

links.searchTemplateNote: Replace {query} with the item words joined by '+' (e.g. https://www.samsclub.com/s/canned+beans).

android.name: Sam's Club
android.note: Google Play package id not confirmed; link opens a Play Store search.

handoff.listFormat: One item per line, plain words plus pack size, e.g. 'Member's Mark chicken breasts 10 lb — 1'. Sam's search works best with short item names.
steps: Tap Copy & open Sam's Club — your list is copied.
In the Sam's Club app, tap Search and paste (or type) one item at a time, then tap Add to cart. Things you've bought before are quickest from your past purchases.
Choose Curbside Pickup at Addison (free, no minimum) or Delivery, and check out.
Shopping in the club instead? Use Scan & Go in the app and check items off here as you go.
confirmed: Curbside Pickup is free with no minimum and Delivery is $10 extra, per the Addison club page (2026-11-14).
Scan & Go is in the Sam's Club app (App Store description).
unconfirmed: No 'paste a whole list' import was found for Sam's Club; the app's App Store notes (through v26.11.21, Nov 2026) mention no shopping-list import or AI assistant.

Walmart's 'Sparky' AI assistant: not confirmed inside the Sam's Club app as of Nov 2026. Walmart's Oct 2025 OpenAI announcement says customers and Sam's Club members will be able to plan meals and restock through ChatGPT, but no Sam's list-to-cart feature was confirmed.
Sam's Club has saved shopping lists and a reorder/past-purchases view on the website and app, but the exact menu path was not confirmed (the help article could not be read).

handoff.listFormat: Plain list, one item per line with an amount, e.g. 'Signature Select spaghetti, 16 oz — 2'. The assistant matches each line to a product.
steps: Tap Copy & open Jewel-Osco — your list is copied.
In the Jewel-Osco app, tap Ask AI (on jewelosco.com it's the AI Shopping Assistant in Meals Hub), paste the list, and ask it to add everything to your cart.
Check each match (brand and size) in the cart and make sure the store is Roosevelt & Park, Glen Ellyn.
Choose DriveUp & Go pickup or delivery and check out. If Ask AI isn't there, search each item and tap Add.
confirmed: Albertsons' AI Shopping Assistant (announced Dec 3, 2025) lets you type a list or upload a picture of a written grocery list and finds products for each item; it is on all banner websites, including Jewel-Osco, in Meals Hub.
At launch it was website-only, with the mobile apps planned for early 2026.
The Jewel-Osco app listing (updated Nov 11, 2026) advertises 'Ask AI' and building repeatable shopping lists and grocery lists from recipes.
unconfirmed: The exact button path to Ask AI inside the Jewel-Osco app.
Whether the in-app Ask AI accepts a pasted multi-item list the same way the website assistant does.
